articles.description: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.

articles.description: The tenant of the flat in Madrid, Maricarmen, was unable to pay the rent set by the firm which recently bought it.

articles.summary: インドの選挙委員会が、委員長に対する新たな疑惑で再び信頼性の危機に直面している。

articles.summary: カナダの毒物販売事件で、英国人生存者が公判で「自身の絶望が悪用された」と証言した。

articles.title: Political psychology: Why extremist parties are thriving and what democratic politicians can do against it
articles.description: Far-right and far-left parties are celebrating success after success, leaving moderate politicians in the dust. Many Germans worry about this. Political psychology helps us understand what's behind growing polarization.
articles.titleJa: 政治心理学：なぜ過激派政党が台頭し、民主主義の政治家は何ができるのか
articles.summary: 過激派政党が台頭し、穏健派政治家が苦戦する状況に対し、多くのドイツ国民が懸念。政治心理学がこの偏極化の背景を解明し、民主主義の政治家が取るべき対応を探る。

articles.title: How the Tigray war could spill across the Horn of Africa
articles.description: Fighting has resumed in Ethiopia's Tigray region. In an interview with DW, Horn of Africa expert Martin Plaut warns of possible regional spillover.
articles.titleJa: ティグレ紛争がアフリカの角地域に波及する可能性
articles.summary: エチオピアのティグレ地域で戦闘が再開。アフリカの角専門家マーティン・プラウト氏は、紛争が地域全体に波及する可能性について警告している。

articles.title: US-China talks on trade, AI between Trump, Xi beckon
articles.description: The presidents of the world's two largest economies are in Washington for what Donald Trump has billed a "big day." Bilateral trade, AI and geopolitics are all on the menu. Follow DW for the latest.

articles.title: EU to condemn war in Ukraine at G20 even if Putin attends
articles.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin has been invited to the G20 summit in Miami by the United States. Multiple members of the group have called for Moscow's exclusion over its invasion of Ukraine.
articles.titleJa: G20でEUはプーチン大統領が出席してもウクライナ戦争を非難する方針
articles.summary: ロシア大統領プーチンが米国マイアミで開催されるG20サミットに招待された。EUは、プーチンが出席してもウクライナ侵攻を非難する意向を示している。

articles.title: AI systems shifted their answers toward both left- and right-leaning users in a study. Could sycophantic chatbots deepen political divides?
articles.description: A study shows chatbots mirror users' politics, part of a broader tendency known as AI sycophancy. Researchers fear this could deepen polarization.

articles.summary: ある研究で、AIチャットボットがユーザーの政治的傾向に迎合する特性が示された。研究者らは、これが政治的二極化を深める可能性を懸念している。

articles.title: Germany news: Berlin officially withdraws Olympics bid
articles.description: Berlin's decision to withdraw its Olympic bid means that only Munich and the western Rhine/Ruhr region are left in the running as potential Olympic hosts. DW has more.

articles.summary: ベルリンがオリンピック招致活動から正式に撤退した。これにより、ドイツ国内ではミュンヘンとライン/ルール地方のみが開催候補地として残ることになる。

articles.title: Czech PM Andrej Babis reiterates importance of NATO for his country but rejects calls to increase defense spending
articles.description: The US and NATO want Czechia to spend more on defense. Czech Prime Minister Andrej Babis says Prague cannot afford faster increases, despite growing warnings about the threat from Russia.

articles.title: 'Pope fever' takes hold as Pope Leo visits France
articles.description: Pope Leo XIV is expected to draw large crowds during his visit to France. As part of his trip to Europe, he's also set to address the continent's future and some of the challenges ahead.
articles.titleJa: レオ法王のフランス訪問で「法王熱」が高まる
articles.summary: レオ14世法王がフランスを訪問し、大勢の人々を魅了すると予想される。法王は欧州の未来と課題について演説する予定で、社会的な注目を集めている。

articles.title: UNGA: Netanyahu, Abbas to speak as Middle East dominates day
articles.description: Israel's Netanyahu can expect to be greeted by protests, while the Palestinian Abbas will address the body via video after the US denied him a visa. Beyond the Middle East, rising sea levels will be on the day 3 agenda.

articles.summary: 国連総会でイスラエルのネタニヤフとパレスチナのアッバスが演説。アッバスは米国によるビザ拒否のためビデオ登壇となる。中東問題と海面上昇が主要議題。

articles.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
articles.description: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.
articles.titleJa: EUが東南アジアとの自由貿易を進める中、なぜASEAN全体との協定がないのか？
articles.summary: EUは長年の交渉を経て、東南アジア各国との二国間貿易協定を進めている。しかし、EUとASEAN間のブロック単位の協定は依然として実現が遠い状況である。

articles.title: Fears of return to war as Tigray rebels launch offensive against Ethiopian army
articles.description:
Fighting escalates after TPLF forms new rebel coalition aimed at overthrowing Abiy Ahmed government 
There are growing fears of a return to civil war in Ethiopia after an offensive by rebels from Tigray into the neighbouring states of Afar and Amhara, and the formation of a new rebel coalition aimed at overthrowing the government of the prime minister, Abiy Ahmed.
Fighting from 2020 to 2022 between the Ethiopian army and the political party and paramilitary group Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) killed about 600,000 people. Both sides are now accusing the other of triggering a return to open conflict.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ティグライ反乱軍がエチオピア軍に対する攻勢を開始し、戦争再発の懸念高まる
articles.summary: ティグライ反乱軍がエチオピア軍に対し攻勢を開始し、内戦再発の懸念が高まっている。過去の紛争で約60万人が死亡しており、政府転覆を狙う新たな反乱軍連合も形成された。

articles.title: Indian billionaire’s payments firm plots biggest London flotation in years
articles.description:
Sunil Bharti Mittal’s Airtel Money targets $9bn IPO in boost for ailing UK stock market
Nils Pratley: Does this mark the end of London’s listing drought? Not yet
A payments business that operates across Africa and is ultimately controlled by an Indian billionaire has announced its intention to float on the struggling London Stock Exchange.
Airtel Money, the mobile money arm of Airtel Africa, is planning one of the biggest UK listings in years, in a boost for the shrinking London market that has faced a string of recent departures.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: インドの億万長者の決済会社がロンドンで数年ぶりの大規模上場を計画
articles.summary: インドの億万長者が所有するアフリカ全土で事業を展開する決済企業エアテル・マネーが、ロンドン証券取引所で数年ぶりの大規模な新規株式公開（IPO）を計画している。

articles.title: Top South African police officer charged with raping woman, 18, and grooming 16-year-old girl
articles.description:
Arrest of Shadrack Sibiya comes as country reels from cases of femicide and alleged police corruption and criminality
One of South Africa’s most senior police officers has been charged with raping an 18-year-old woman and grooming a 16-year-old girl, as the country’s police face allegations of corruption and failing to tackle violence against women and girls.
Shadrack Sibiya, who was already suspended from his role as deputy national police commissioner over allegations he interfered with political killings investigations, was arrested on Monday. He is facing charges of rape, people trafficking, promoting the sexual grooming of a child and two counts of grooming a child.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 南アフリカの警察幹部が18歳女性へのレイプと16歳少女のグルーミングで起訴
articles.summary: 南アフリカの警察幹部が18歳女性へのレイプと16歳少女のグルーミングの罪で起訴された。これは、フェミサイドや警察の汚職が問題となる同国で大きな波紋を呼んでいる。

articles.title: Healthcare in Africa ‘under growing strain’ after US withdrawal from aid programs, report warns
articles.description:
Accra Reset’s report states countries in the region and global south should take greater control of their health development after USAID debacle
The United States’ withdrawal from key aid programs has put healthcare in Africa and the global south “under growing strain” a new report warns.
The report says the Trump administration’s cuts to programs such as US Agency for International Development (USAID), as well as the Covid-19 pandemic and rising costs of living globally have brought “new urgency” for the need to reform healthcare in the region.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 米国の援助プログラム撤退後、アフリカの医療が「増大する負担」に直面、報告書が警告
articles.summary: 報告書によると、米国の主要な援助プログラム撤退後、アフリカとグローバルサウスの医療が「増大する負担」に直面している。地域は医療開発のより大きな自主管理を求められている。

articles.title: Banished to alien lands: Trump’s secret deportation deals
articles.description:
After a plane journey in shackles, an Iranian woman found herself in the middle of Africa in a country she did not know existed. She is one of thousands deported from the US on the back of shadowy deals made with dozens of countries. An in-depth investigation reveals the ‘show of force’ costing American taxpayers millions
No one would tell the shackled detainees onboard the US immigration plane where they were going. The officers in charge would taunt them when they asked, they said. It was only when the seat-back video screens finally showed a map that the 18 migrants worked it out.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 異国の地へ追放：トランプ政権の秘密裏の国外追放協定
articles.summary: トランプ政権下の秘密裏の国外追放協定により、数千人が米国から見知らぬ国へ追放されている。イラン人女性がアフリカに送られた事例など、米国民の税金を投じた「威嚇」の実態が明らかに。

articles.title: Milei threatens at UN that Argentina will take ‘matters into our own hands’ on Falklands
articles.description:
Argentinian president accuses United Nations of being filled with ‘parasites’ in bellicose general assembly speech
Javier Milei has condemned the UN as he warned that Argentina would take “matters into our own hands” in its dispute with Britain over the sovereignty of the Falkland Islands.
In a caustic speech at the general assembly in New York, the Argentinian president criticised the UN for being ineffective when it came to the long-running tensions over the British overseas territory in the south Atlantic known in Argentina as the Malvinas.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ミレイ大統領、国連でフォークランド諸島問題はアルゼンチンが「自力で解決する」と威嚇
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領は国連総会で、フォークランド諸島（マルビナス諸島）の主権問題に関して、アルゼンチンが「自力で解決する」と威嚇。国連の無効性を批判した。

articles.title: Delcy Rodríguez poses with Trump in New York as Maduro languishes in jail nearby
articles.description:
Venezuela’s interim president hails ‘historic meeting’ and does not say whether she will visit snatched predecessor
Venezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, has celebrated a “historic” meeting with Donald Trump in New York, posing for a smiley photo with the US president, less than nine months after he ordered the abduction of her boss, Nicolás Maduro.
The former foes met at a five-star hotel a few blocks from Trump Tower in Manhattan late on Tuesday on the sidelines of the UN general assembly. The hotel is about 7 miles from the Brooklyn prison where Maduro has been held since he was snatched during a special forces raid on Caracas in January.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: デルシー・ロドリゲスがニューヨークでトランプとポーズ、その間マドゥロは近くの刑務所で拘束
articles.summary: ベネズエラのデルシー・ロドリゲス暫定大統領がニューヨークでドナルド・トランプと会談し「歴史的会談」を祝った。これは、彼女の上司であるニコラス・マドゥロが近くの刑務所に拘束されている中で行われた。

articles.title: Jamaica hails King’s decision to refer slavery reparations petition to privy council as ‘really big deal’
articles.description:
The move comes after Jamaica’s culture minister Olivia Grange travelled to the UK earlier this month to lodge the historic petition
King Charles has referred a landmark slavery reparations petition from Jamaica to a high-level UK appeals court for legal advice, Jamaica’s culture minister announced in parliament on Tuesday.
Referring to the move as a “really big deal”, Olivia Grange told Jamaica’s MPs the monarch had confirmed that their legal questions have been passed on to the London-based privy council – the final court of appeal for UK overseas territories and some Commonwealth countries.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ジャマイカ、国王が奴隷賠償請願を枢密院に付託する決定を「非常に大きな出来事」と歓迎
articles.summary: ジャマイカは、国王チャールズが奴隷賠償に関する画期的な請願を英国の枢密院に付託する決定をしたことを「非常に大きな出来事」と称賛した。これは歴史的な動きとして注目されている。

articles.title: Hurricane Polo, rapidly intensifying from strong El Niño patterns, rages off coast of Mexico
articles.description:
Polo, with sustained winds of 165mph, is churning 215 miles south of Zihuatanejo but is unlikely to directly hit Mexico
A tropical storm off the south-west coast of Mexico has intensified into a category 5 monster in fewer than 24 hours, fueled by stronger than usual El Niño weather patterns in the Pacific Ocean.
Hurricane Polo was sending out maximum sustained winds of 165mph (266km/h) on Tuesday as its center churned about 215 miles (346km) south of the coastal city of Zihuatanejo, in Guerrero state.
 Continue reading...

articles.title: Trump’s threat to annihilate Iran to UN general assembly is stunning, even for him
articles.description:
US president may have upstaged the ghost of Soviet leader Khrushchev by musing destruction of fellow member state
Donald Trump has a habit of discomfiting delegates to the United Nations general assembly. But this year, he may have upstaged the ghost of Nikita Khrushchev by openly contemplating the annihilation of a fellow UN member state.
Eleven minutes into a 40-minute address, the US president announced he had “a big decision to make” over Iran, which has staged a much more determined resistance than Trump anticipated when he decided to go to war against the country in February.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ大統領の国連総会でのイラン壊滅発言は彼にしては衝撃的
articles.summary: トランプ前米大統領が国連総会でイラン壊滅を公然と示唆し、その発言は過去の彼の言動からしても異例の衝撃を与えた。この発言は、イランとの緊張関係をさらに高めるものだ。

articles.title: Bentley launches its first EV, and it could be its cheapest model
articles.description: Bentley’s first fully electric car tests wealthy buyers’ appetite for luxury EVs, and it comes with a €408 million investment in its Crewe factory. The launch supports existing jobs at a time when several high-end rivals have delayed or dropped plans for electric models.
articles.titleJa: ベントレーが初のEVを発表、最も安価なモデルになる可能性も
articles.summary: ベントレーが初の完全電気自動車を発表。クルー工場に4億800万ユーロを投資し、高級EV市場での富裕層の需要を探る。

articles.title: Greece sounds alarm over fake eye therapies: From iridology to 'no-glasses' exercises
articles.description: The Hellenic Ophthalmological Society (HOS) is sounding the alarm, urging the public not to trust unproven, non-evidence-based practices.

articles.summary: ギリシャ眼科学会が、虹彩診断や「メガネ不要」運動など、根拠のない非科学的な眼科治療法を信頼しないよう国民に警告している。

articles.title: The Sound of Music: Austrian museum pays tribute to Von Trapp family and Hollywood musical
articles.description: Over sixty years since its release, 'The Sound of Music' now has a dedicated museum in Salzburg, which combines history with Hollywood to celebrate the remarkable story of the Von Trapp family.
articles.titleJa: 『サウンド・オブ・ミュージック』：オーストリアの博物館がフォン・トラップ一家とハリウッドミュージカルに敬意を表す
articles.summary: 映画公開から60年以上を経て、ザルツブルクに『サウンド・オブ・ミュージック』専門博物館がオープン。フォン・トラップ一家の物語を歴史とハリウッドを融合させて紹介。

articles.title: Video shows UK fighter jet crashing during training

articles.titleJa: 訓練中に英国戦闘機が墜落する動画
articles.summary: 英国空軍のホーク戦闘機が北ウェールズでの訓練中に墜落する様子を捉えた映像が公開された。

articles.title: Milan exhibition explores the enduring bond between Salvador Dalí and fashion
articles.description: A new exhibition at Milan’s Palazzo Reale explores the Dalí’s love affair with fashion, from his collaborations with Elsa Schiaparelli in the 1930s to the designers still borrowing from his surreal visual world today.
articles.titleJa: ミラノの展覧会、サルバドール・ダリとファッションの永続的な絆を探る
articles.summary: ミラノのパラッツォ・レアーレで開催中の新展覧会で、サルバドール・ダリとファッション界との関係、特にエルザ・スキャパレッリとのコラボレーションが紹介される。

articles.title: People battle huge waves to save boat in Acapulco during Hurricane Polo
articles.description: Residents of Acapulco haul a boat to safety as heavy swells batter Mexico’s Pacific coast and Hurricane Polo passes offshore, downgraded from Category 5.
articles.titleJa: アカプルコでハリケーン・ポロの中、人々が巨大な波と戦いボートを救う
articles.summary: ハリケーン・ポロがメキシコの太平洋岸を通過する中、アカプルコの住民が巨大な高波と戦いながらボートを安全な場所に引き上げた。

articles.title: Finance Watch warns of online tactics designed to influence retail investors
articles.description: Online design tactics can influence consumers and retail investors, including minors, to make decisions that may not be in their best interests, while making information about potential risks less prominent, Finance Watch has warned.
articles.titleJa: ファイナンス・ウォッチが個人投資家に影響を与えるオンライン戦術に警告
articles.summary: ファイナンス・ウォッチは、オンラインのデザイン戦術が消費者を誤った投資判断に導き、潜在的なリスク情報を目立たなくしていると警告した。

articles.title: EU vows to condemn Russia at G20 summit, regardless of Putin's attendance
articles.description: The United States has formally invited Vladimir Putin to attend the G20 summit in Miami. But the European Union says its approach will not change and will condemn Russia's war on Ukraine regardless.
articles.titleJa: EU、プーチン出席の有無にかかわらずG20サミットでロシアを非難すると誓う
articles.summary: 米国がプーチン大統領をG20サミットに招待する中、EUは、ロシアのウクライナ侵攻を非難するという姿勢は変わらないと表明した。

articles.title: How are Danes reacting to the US-Greenland security deal?

articles.title: A critical juncture for the world trading system: what the evidence tells us
articles.description: The multilateral trading system has underpinned a nearly 50-fold expansion of world merchandise trade volume and one of the most remarkable periods of economic growth and development in modern history, yet global trade policy and the WTO are experiencing the most serious and sustained disruptions since the system was created 80 years ago.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易システムにとっての岐路：証拠が示すもの
articles.summary: 多国間貿易システムは80年ぶりに深刻な混乱に直面しており、その現状と課題について考察。世界貿易政策の転換点を示す。

articles.title: Tariffs applied by WTO members have decreased by a third since 1996

articles.title: Report spotlights role of services export promotion strategies as catalyst for development
articles.description: A new report launched by the WTO Secretariat and the UN Economic Commission for Latin America and the Caribbean (UNECLAC) on 17 September draws on case studies to illustrate how developing economies' export promotion strategies can help them take advantage of growing opportunities in services trade. Export Promotion Strategies for Services: Lessons from the Developing World provides useful policy insights for developing economies, underscoring the importance of close coordination with skills upgrading and investment attraction strategies and the need to adapt export promotion mechanisms traditionally focused on goods.
articles.titleJa: サービス輸出促進戦略が開発の触媒となる役割に焦点を当てた報告書

articles.title: Young Trade Leaders meet with DG; discuss AI, environment, needs of developing economies
articles.description: Artificial intelligence (AI), the environment, and issues facing developing economies were among the topics discussed by Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala and the latest cohort of WTO Young Trade Leaders at a meeting on 17 September. The Director-General underlined that harnessing the energy and ideas of young people is essential for addressing current and future trade challenges.
articles.titleJa: 若手貿易リーダーが事務局長と会談。AI、環境、開発途上国のニーズを議論

articles.title: WTO Public Forum 2026 spotlights role of services in driving world trade
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the WTO's Public Forum kicked off on 15 September in Geneva under the theme Powering the Future. Over three days, the Forum will welcome more than 4,600 participants from business, governments, civil society, academia and international organizations to discuss how trade in services is a key engine of development, a source of income, and a driver of job creation and empowerment worldwide.
articles.titleJa: WTO公共フォーラム2026、世界貿易を牽引するサービス貿易の役割に焦点
articles.summary: ジュネーブで開催されたWTO公共フォーラム2026が、世界貿易におけるサービス貿易の重要性を強調。開発と雇用創出の推進力として議論。

articles.title: World Trade Report: Trade reform to boost growth; inaction can cost 10% global GDP
articles.description: The 2026 edition of the World Trade Report – issued on 15 September - finds that a strengthened multilateral trading system could increase global GDP by roughly 3% or USD 3 trillion by 2050, while inaction to modernize the trading system could reduce global output by up to 10%. The flagship publication of the WTO Secretariat, examining what the multilateral trading system has delivered over 80 years and where it is facing challenges, offers evidence relevant to ongoing efforts to keep trade rules fit for purpose.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易報告書：貿易改革が成長を促進、無策は世界GDPの10%を失う可能性
articles.summary: 2026年版世界貿易報告書は、貿易システムの強化が2050年までに世界GDPを3%増加させる一方、無策だと10%減少させると警告している。

articles.title: World Trade & Tech Day: AI and trade increasingly intertwined
articles.description: Hundreds of participants gathered at the WTO for World Trade & Tech Day on 14 September, a sign of how AI is fundamentally changing the way cross-border commerce is evolving. Under the banner of "AI and Trade: Turning Potential into Progress", the day consisted of a full day of panel discussions and other knowledge-sharing opportunities aimed at fostering conversations on technology and trade. The event shone a spotlight on how AI and frontier technologies are making international trade more efficient, bringing together government leaders as well as academics and private sector representatives to discuss ways to harness AI's potential into tangible economic gains and an engine for inclusive growth.
articles.titleJa: 世界貿易・技術デー：AIと貿易の結びつきが深まる

articles.summary: ロシア連邦が、ユーラシア経済連合に輸入される特定のポリマー被覆フラット鋼材に対し、セーフガード調査を開始したことをWTOに通知した。

articles.title: WTO study explores the role of stablecoins in international trade
articles.description: The WTO Secretariat launched a new publication on the role of stablecoins in supporting cross-border trade on 14 September on the sidelines of the WTO's first World Trade and Tech Day. The report, prepared by the Economic Research and Statistics Division and the Trade in Services and Investment Division, examines the opportunities and challenges associated with the use of stablecoins in facilitating international trade, highlighting how they can accelerate cross-border payments and their potential to increase participation in the international trading system, especially for developing economies.
articles.titleJa: WTO調査、国際貿易におけるステーブルコインの役割を探る
articles.summary: WTOがステーブルコインが国境を越える貿易を促進し、特に開発途上国の国際貿易システムへの参加を増やす可能性について新たな報告書を発表。

articles.title: Goods barometer points to resilient trade growth despite headwinds
articles.description: Global goods trade continued to strengthen in mid-2026 despite persistent geopolitical and policy-related uncertainties, according to the WTO Goods Trade Barometer released on 9 September 2026.
articles.titleJa: 物品貿易バロメーター、逆風にもかかわらず堅調な貿易成長を示す
articles.summary: WTO物品貿易バロメーターによると、地政学的・政策的不確実性があるにもかかわらず、2026年半ばも世界の物品貿易は引き続き堅調に推移している。
